issues.title: Paper-thin loft floor and apparent upstairs light bleed
issues.symptom: User observed apparent light from above on the under-loft ceiling.
issues.cause: The upper floor had one rendered face, no separate soffit/fascia or structural depth.
issues.action: Added a 160mm authored slab with physical collision, an independent underside and exposed edges; lowered the utility fitting to Y2.84 before grading.
issues.evidence: BlackpineDeckDepthTest fails against pre-fix compiled 4b2bb24: loft needs a real 160mm underside. It passes after correction, including actual triangle area/normals and upstairs circuit isolation. Before/after PNGs: development/levels/previews/defects/ and mill-lighting/.
issues.older_maps: Audit floor depth and cross-storey lighting in House, Farmhouse, School, Church and Castle; depth is opt-in and has only been applied/verified at Blackpine.

issues.title: Corner, floor/wall and wall/roof light bleed
issues.affected: Previously reported joins; broader map set unverified
issues.symptom: User reports light bleed through floor/wall joins and requests corner and roof intersection coverage.
issues.cause: Multiple possible causes: zero-depth geometry, open seams, normals, endpoint sampling or lighting occlusion; do not assume one cause for every join.
issues.action: Audit each surface and circuit pairing using MAP_FITNESS_CHECKLIST.md; log each reproducible location as a linked issue.
issues.evidence: BlackpineLightingTest covers selected wall/floor rays; LightingOcclusionRepairTest covers selected castle planes. These do not certify all corners/roofs.
issues.older_maps: All prior maps require a documented join/corner/roof sweep and matched light-state captures.

issues.title: Black and gray striped procedural metal
issues.affected: Twelve original working-place models plus mill suspension
issues.symptom: Metal developed regular dark/light bandage-like stripes.
issues.cause: Fixed-amplitude sine rows and bright border strips in the procedural metal shader.
issues.action: Rebuilt the working-place family with restrained proportional non-directional patina; suspension uses the corrected material.
issues.evidence: development/levels/MILL_REFINEMENT.md; validate_mill_expansion.py and validate_mill_lighting.py independently inspect packed row contrast below 2.5%.
issues.older_maps: Other historical model families require regeneration, source/hash updates and in-room inspection before being called corrected.

issues.title: Workshop bandsaw used as primary sawmill machine
issues.symptom: Small workshop saw did not fit the logway or sawmill purpose in the supplied reference.
issues.cause: Wrong machine type/scale for processing full logs.
issues.action: Added circular headrig aligned to the log carriage; relocated the small bandsaw to the repair shed.
issues.evidence: BlackpineMillExpansionTest; native blade/log/arbor and bearing checks in validate_mill_expansion.py.
issues.older_maps: Check purpose and human/material scale whenever industrial models are reused.

issues.title: Timber rack intersects ledger table
issues.symptom: Initial rack placement overlapped an existing furnishing.
issues.cause: Bounds were not separated in the first candidate placement.
issues.action: Moved the rack to X60.4/Z20.75; retain source bounds and measured room coordinates.
issues.evidence: BlackpineMillExpansionTest independently checks solid furnishing separation; MILL_REFINEMENT.md records the rejected placement.
issues.older_maps: Run furniture/furniture and furniture/wall checks for all old room kits; tabletop items need actual support-part checks.

issues.title: High mill worklights lack appropriate physical supports
issues.symptom: Worklight arrangement needed real roof attachment and a below-deck fixture.
issues.cause: Ceiling-origin fixtures must be supported at their authored height, not floated or floor-normalized.
issues.action: Added ceiling plates, suspension rods, crossbar, junction and protected electrical drop; corrected under-loft mount after slab addition.
issues.evidence: BlackpineLightingTest; validate_mill_lighting.py native contact/pivot checks.
issues.older_maps: Inspect brackets, fixture backs and circuit access at every older site.

issues.title: Added slab blocks final stair approach
issues.affected: Blackpine mill stair; introduced during DEV-001 fix
issues.symptom: BlackpineGrayboxTest failed at ascent step 113 immediately after adding slab collision.
issues.cause: The swept capsule overlaps the final riser before its feet reach landing height.
issues.action: Allow only an authored stair-to-slab landing contact within 200mm of the top and at the actual ramp elevation; other slab edges remain opaque/solid.
issues.evidence: BlackpineGrayboxTest failed before transition correction and passes afterward; swept route test still reaches all 15 zones over 292910 positions.
issues.older_maps: Every structural-depth retrofit must recheck both stair directions and landing transitions.

issues.title: Castle sky variation assertion fails on existing main
issues.symptom: CastleHubIntegrationTest fails its sky color-variation assertion.
issues.cause: Reproduced on unchanged main db9bb0d during branch unification; not attributed to new map assets.
issues.action: Keep open for renderer owner; do not suppress the assertion to claim a full green release.
issues.evidence: development/verification/branch-unification.json and unification-main-baseline.json.
issues.older_maps: Recheck when the responsible renderer change lands; do not silently drop this known failure.

issues.title: Slow software-renderer capture frames
issues.symptom: Capture logs report slow scene assembly/raster frames.
issues.cause: Target-hardware/native OpenGL behavior is not established by headless captures.
issues.action: Retain timings and profile native gameplay before claiming acceptable performance.
issues.evidence: development/levels/verification/blackpine-worklights.json contains actual RENDER SLOW timings.
issues.older_maps: Measure each site on target hardware; do not copy a performance claim from another map.

issues.title: Purchased Tier I flashlight weaker than default
issues.symptom: Tier I was 6m / .58 while the default was 7.5m / .72.
issues.cause: Hardware defaults and tier configuration diverged.
issues.action: All paid tiers now exceed default reach, power and width: 9.5/12.83/16.63m, .98/1.18/1.40 power.
issues.evidence: OpticalEvidenceTest and TieredMediaAndPowerTest; unchanged 280/420/630s host batteries.
issues.older_maps: Inspect actual handheld illumination in older sites, not just numeric stats.

issues.title: GPU handheld flashlight omitted from submitted light
issues.symptom: CPU raster added the held torch per pixel but GPU vertex submission only included room/portable light.
issues.cause: Different CPU/GPU lighting paths omitted the same hardware beam.
issues.action: GPU vertices now include the shared torch profile; CPU retains one beam contribution.
issues.evidence: OpticalEvidenceCapture independently compares actual GPU RGB output for default and purchased torch.
issues.older_maps: Native OpenGL hardware and per-map performance still need acceptance.

issues.title: UV only reports room traces; no purple light or surface splats
issues.affected: UV tool, local solo and LAN
issues.symptom: The UV action produced text from room recency without visible inspection light or positioned decals.
issues.cause: No rendered UV emitter or surface-bound trace representation.
issues.action: Added purple cone, bounded host-authored passage marks, geometric reveal, switch/battery state and textured shallow surface cubes.
issues.evidence: OpticalEvidenceTest covers genuine/absent/expired traces, direction, six mounting normals and texture; OpticalEvidenceCapture verifies real purple/green pixels; LanOpticalEvidenceNetworkTest uses real sockets and tests depletion/privacy.
issues.older_maps: Current producer leaves supported floor residue. Six-axis cube support does not mean wall/ceiling contact producers or teammate UV spill have been implemented; those remain separate refinements.

issues.title: D.O.T.S. generated a body-wide pattern instead of intersecting projector rays
issues.symptom: The first correction sampled the entire rounded capsule, producing dots unrelated to the real stationary/panning projector rays.
issues.cause: Mistook a receiving collision volume for a source of points; user caught the incorrect interpretation.
issues.action: Removed all capsule sampling and floating grid dots. Shared source rays now choose exactly one nearest room/prop or front ghost intersection; heading, panning and elevation replicate.
issues.evidence: DotsRayFieldTest checks transferred wall hit, front side only, blocker priority, miss/range/heading, static Tier I and panning II/III; controlled runtime pair and photographed pixels.
issues.older_maps: Standing capsule approximates collision volume only. Actual native moving-ghost, multi-PC camera and per-site performance acceptance remain pending; do not promote based on headless captures.

issues.title: Laser evidence has text but no visible physical distortion
issues.symptom: Device returned generic readings without a rendered beam/ghost intersection effect.
issues.cause: No spatial grid geometry or optical-contact event.
issues.action: Added placed tiered beam fans clipped by architecture, exact horizontal beam/capsule intervals and spirals only within those intervals; host-authorized events, battery state, camera views and photographs.
issues.evidence: OpticalEvidenceTest rejects non-intersections and checks fixed endpoints; OpticalEvidenceCapture compares straight/distorted pixels and photographs.
issues.older_maps: Per-site and native hardware performance still require review; species/quota/event rules remain authoritative.

issues.title: New laser station falls through to thermometer readout
issues.affected: Laser station integration, discovered during this pass
issues.symptom: After enabling laser station placement, the general station reader would treat it as a thermometer.
issues.cause: The old reader only distinguished EMF from other pre-existing sensor types.
issues.action: Use one laserContact calculation for both optical events and station readings; label laser stations L on the van map.
issues.evidence: LanOpticalEvidenceNetworkTest now waits for the real SENSOR READ packet and rejects unrelated thermometer output.
issues.older_maps: Audit device-specific dispatch when adding a new shared station type.

issues.title: UTF-8 UI labels corrupted by editing script
issues.affected: Two local Java edits during this pass
issues.symptom: The regression test detected a corrupted pound sign and other non-ASCII labels before publication.
issues.cause: A Windows-default cp1252 read was written as UTF-8.
issues.action: Restored original UTF-8 text and retained only intended source changes; all future scripts use explicit encoding.
issues.evidence: EquipmentStoreDescriptionsTest reproduced the failure and passes after correction; review the scoped diff for unrelated text changes.
issues.older_maps: Do not rewrite historical Unicode text via platform-default encoding.

issues.title: Pavilion native inspection was too dark to review joins
issues.symptom: Sun-only inspection left roof underside and timber bearing faces nearly black.
issues.cause: Open shelter shadows without adequate inspection illumination.
issues.action: Add explicitly labeled authoring-only camera area fill; recapture the same native joints. This does not add a gameplay fixture or certify runtime lighting.
issues.evidence: previews/defects/DEV-017-before-pavilion-join.png and refreshed pavilion-join-native-fitout.png; actual mesh contact and roof-depth validator.
issues.older_maps: Native review images must make the inspected details readable; perform separate real circuit/portable-light runtime reviews.

issues.title: Blender scene reload invalidated an old material handle
issues.affected: New pavilion builder, before first scene save
issues.symptom: Builder raised StructRNA material removed while creating apron strips after opening the prior native file.
issues.cause: Retained an in-memory material reference across open_mainfile.
issues.action: Resolve/create apron material in the newly loaded scene before use; rerun builder and independent source-preservation checks.
issues.evidence: build_hollow_creek_pavilion.py completes and validate_hollow_creek_pavilion.py reopens both deliveries.
issues.older_maps: Never carry Blender object/material references across a file reload; preserve originals on generation failure.

issues.title: Hollow Creek structures advanced before continuous site terrain
issues.affected: Camp Hollow Creek authoring order and all future map gates
issues.symptom: Tables and pavilion were refined on isolated rough pads and schematic paths before the terrain, shoreline, creek and approach were validated.
issues.cause: Promoted facility and architecture refinement before the site-foundation gate.
issues.action: Preserve authored structures; put terrain, water, drainage, foundation pads, van access and supported circulation first. Add a dedicated site terrain contract and independent surface checks before more facilities.
issues.evidence: hollow-creek-terrain.json: 10,377 full-width native route samples, 72 foundation samples, actual drainage/bed checks and exact runtime GLB loading; runtime map integration remains pending.
issues.older_maps: Audit terrain/site support first at every older location; never infer route support from graph connectivity or a planning line.

issues.title: First terrain pass left a dry sill across the creek mouth
issues.symptom: Review of the water-crossings view exposed an isolated creek strip instead of a connected lake outlet.
issues.cause: Both creek ends faded to dry ground, including its lake mouth.
issues.action: Continue the carved creek bed into the lake; retain the inland headwater transition. Independently sample the actual native mesh along the full wet channel.
issues.evidence: DEV-020-before-creek-mouth.png, corrected terrain-water-crossings-native-fitout.png and 113 native bed ray checks below water.
issues.older_maps: Check drainage continuity at every channel-to-waterbody junction; a blue surface is not proof of a connected carved bed.

issues.title: Terrain draft exceeded the runtime GLB primitive budget
issues.symptom: Actual game loader rejected the first terrain GLB with Triangle buffer budget, despite native mesh checks passing.
issues.cause: A whole-site flat-normal/cube-UV primitive exceeded existing per-primitive vertex/index limits.
issues.action: Use shared site UVs, spatial primitives and a bounded grid with exact foundation/crossing axes. Respect both per-primitive and 50,000-total-triangle limits; no engine limits changed.
issues.evidence: HollowCreekTerrainAssetTest now passes on the final exported GLB, with source UVs, upward normals, actual metre bounds and negative bed elevations.
issues.older_maps: Always load new terrain exports through the actual runtime loader; native Blender validity does not prove runtime compatibility.

issues.title: First terrain draft flattened all outdoor pads and trails to Y0
issues.symptom: Initial terrain left the usable site too flat and showed square outdoor reservations as if they were finished areas.
issues.cause: Preserved every provisional standing Y rather than designing terrain-led grades and fitting facilities.
issues.action: Create descending road-to-lake grades, incised narrow treads, irregular shoreline/creek and an irregular boundary contract. Keep only needed foundations level; hide reservation boxes in default review views and refit the existing table/fire ring vertically.
issues.evidence: Native site/close-trail captures; measured bed range, two shoulder rises, 1.5m van pad and -1.3m lakeshore anchors in terrain report.
issues.older_maps: Audit terrain-led foundation heights and organic outdoor edges before further buildings or detail. Boundary barriers and runtime integration remain separate unfinished gates.

issues.title: New trail grading introduced steep junction and crossing-edge transitions
issues.symptom: Actual native triangle normals found steep full-width path edges near a foundation corner and crossing abutments.
issues.cause: Nearest-branch height discontinuities, incision against rigid foundations and soil interpolation at deck ends.
issues.action: Blend trail junction profiles, reroute approaches onto dry banks, taper incision into hardscape and align terrain axes/abutments with the decks. Checker gives the deck its exact standing face at coincident boundary hits.
issues.evidence: Independent native ray checks now pass all 10,377 full-width samples; measured worst local grade 0.192827, below the stated 0.20 authoring threshold. This is not human/runtime traversal acceptance.
issues.older_maps: Check full-width terrain normals and transitions, not graph connectivity or centre lines alone. Preserve failures when adding erosion or changing foundation heights.

issues.title: Rough diagram connectors obscured new terrain review views
issues.symptom: Inherited colored route/ritual markers and floating upper floor plates made the terrain overview look like unfinished structure geometry.
issues.cause: Retained source blockout visualization objects were rendered as if they were terrain infrastructure.
issues.action: Preserve all original source objects/files; hide schematic markers and upper layers in default ground overview. Provide separately labeled layer-study captures and engineering-pending metadata.
issues.evidence: DEV-024-before-terrain-review.png and corrected per-site native terrain overviews; actual retained floor transforms remain tested.
issues.older_maps: Keep terrain reviews readable and distinguish planning markers, foundation plates and actual completed structures.

issues.title: Terrain review missed split floor pieces with numbered names
issues.symptom: A refresh failed on Floor west.001; inherited floor chunks around openings were not all assigned to their source zone by filename.
issues.cause: Display/verification filters treated a numbered object name as the authoritative zone ID.
issues.action: Use the authored zone property, with a conservative name fallback, for every floor part. Recompute retained-part lists and verify all source floor geometry/placements remain intact.
issues.evidence: refresh_terrain_foundation_views.py and the per-site native layer checks; original blockouts retain hashes.
issues.older_maps: Floor openings often split a slab into several objects. Ownership must follow authored metadata, never an assumed unique mesh name.

issues.title: Broad terrain pass exposes unresolved grade and crossing support locations
issues.affected: Sixteen remaining rough development sites; six new-location proposal diagnostics tracked separately
issues.symptom: Actual native level-link probes flagged 937 sampled support/grade locations; canyon and railway account for the largest groups.
issues.cause: Existing coarse connector reservations and new first-pass terrain heights still need fine grading, engineered crossings, stair/rock-volume work and exact surface ownership.
issues.action: Keep each location and unengineered transition in the per-site verification reports. Prioritize canyon/rail terrain refinement; do not promote broad foundation checks to navigation acceptance or unlock missions.
issues.evidence: development/levels/verification/terrain-foundations.json and terrain-foundations/<key>/verification.json contain every diagnostic position and scope. Additional new-location-native.json retains 127 terrain-only sampled findings out of 399 probes. These include deck/walkway points and are not unique defects or a swept route acceptance.
issues.older_maps: Apply actual full-width/swept traversal review before detail work; graph connectivity and native floor plates are not proof of a usable route.

issues.title: New lighthouse wall rings stopped short of the next storey
issues.symptom: Visible horizontal gaps remained between circular wall rings.
issues.cause: Standing levels were spaced 3.6 m apart while the initial wall height was 3.0 m.
issues.action: Extend each authored tower wall ring to the next standing level; regenerate and reopen only the new lighthouse packet.
issues.evidence: development/levels/previews/defects/DEV-027-before-tower-storey-gaps.png; new-location-native.json measures five continuous wall-level joins; corrected native overview.
issues.older_maps: Audit storey spacing against actual wall top/roof/underside coordinates. A continuous rough ring is not a passed runtime lighting test.

issues.title: New rough connector meshes had no UV layer
issues.symptom: Independent GLB reload failed the all-mesh UV presence check.
issues.cause: The old rough route-strip generator authored position faces without texture coordinates.
issues.action: Before saving/exporting new terrain-tagged proposals, add finite metre-plan UVs to meshes lacking a UV layer; retain existing UVs and old maps.
issues.evidence: development/quality/evidence/DEV-028-native-uv-before.txt records the initial failure; independent rerun development/levels/verification/new-location-native.json passes all six actual GLB UV/finite geometry checks.
issues.older_maps: Audit legacy route-strip UVs before applying textured finishes. Presence of UVs alone does not establish correct material scale or finish quality.

issues.title: Shared procedural hill silhouette conflicts with site-specific open horizons
issues.affected: All-map background silhouette; coastal/wetland/new high-view sites require individual review
issues.symptom: SceneRenderer.paintSky unconditionally paints a trigonometric hill silhouette for all map backgrounds, including proposed open-water views.
issues.cause: One common horizon composition has no map-specific sector masks or horizon profile.
issues.action: Per-map boundary/sky plans now reserve distinct water, field, roof, woodland, mesa and mountain sectors. Coordinate a separately tested renderer integration; no engine code changed in this planning batch.
issues.evidence: src/main/java/org/beckenburg/SceneRenderer.java paintSky; development/levels/edge-sky-plans/*/plan.json and per-map planning diagrams.
issues.older_maps: Audit 360-degree ground and highest-window/tower views, CPU/GPU depth behavior, sky leaks and weather parity before claiming a finished skyline.

issues.title: Legacy model-worklist generator assumed the original fixed roster
issues.affected: Model requirements catalog maintenance after adding WLD-14 through WLD-18
issues.symptom: Source inspection found unconditional global regeneration, a SPECIAL lookup limited to the original maps and a final 23-map assertion; rerunning would overwrite curated packets or fail on new IDs.
issues.cause: The legacy generator combined initial worklist creation and catalog refresh into one unguarded fixed-roster script.
issues.action: Make the public entry point refresh/validate only the catalog from existing worklists. Preserve authored JSON/Markdown; support original and new room schemas and separate annexes. Disable legacy global regeneration.
issues.evidence: development/levels/model-requirements/refresh_catalog.py; build_requirements.py now reports 28 base maps and one additive expansion; source-hash and per-room counts checked.
issues.older_maps: Do not globally regenerate curated worklists to append a map. Refresh catalogs from actual packets; retain source references and existing map geometry.

issues.title: First land boundary read as a uniform wall in an underlit review
issues.symptom: Continuous steep core, block stones and dark inspection framing hid natural edge fitness.
issues.cause: Rough authoring assumptions were not sufficient; independent geometry and ordinary-view review exposed the issue.
issues.action: Slope the bank profile, add embedded rocks/rooted growth and retain inspection lighting. Further fine art review remains open.

issues.older_maps: Audit this category on each older map; a corrected Hollow Creek derivative or passing source check does not establish other-map acceptance.

issues.older_maps: Audit this category on each older map; a corrected Hollow Creek derivative or passing source check does not establish other-map acceptance.

issues.cause: Rough authoring assumptions were not sufficient; independent geometry and ordinary-view review exposed the issue.

issues.title: Coarse tree crowns and surface breakup did not meet requested art quality

issues.cause: Rough authoring assumptions were not sufficient; independent geometry and ordinary-view review exposed the issue.
issues.action: Replace rounded pine masses with attached fine branch/needle sprays, increase original diffuse detail, add supplemental alpha crowns on solid trunks, and add protected close ferns. Preserve rejected rounded-canopy evidence. Continue reviewing broadleaf/shrub/rock art and runtime alpha/LOD behavior; do not call the whole art pass accepted.

issues.title: Initial tent entries and bedding were not fit for the authored crouch body
issues.symptom: Initial ridge door matched the 1.05m crouch height without head margin; one dome pole crossed the entrance; a bedding corner extended past the actual inset floor.

issues.action: Raise the ridge entry to 1.20m and ridge to 1.90m, move dome poles onto diagonal support arcs, author an oval inset floor and refit the existing bedroll entirely onto it. Validate the current body capsule, native floor faces and mat/roll underside contact.
issues.evidence: development/levels/previews/defects/DEV-038-before-dome-entry-pole.png; development/quality/evidence/DEV-038-before-tent-fit.json; DEV-038-first-native-tent-check.json; development/levels/verification/hollow-creek-tents.json
issues.older_maps: Measure real body/door and support-part clearance. Do not infer usable entrances from an open-looking model or use an overall bounding box as its floor.

issues.title: Unused canopy vertices overstated the native source bounds
issues.affected: New dome tent source mesh and metadata
issues.symptom: Source bounds included unreferenced vertices in the cut doorway that were correctly absent from actual GLB triangles. An initial origin assertion also assumed symmetric guys despite intentionally omitting the doorway guy.
issues.cause: The cut canopy retained orphan vertices, while the metadata helper measured every vertex rather than only actual faces.
issues.action: Remove 21 orphan vertices, merge the canopy apex/closed seams before solidifying, and validate real GLB triangle bounds plus the actual floor component. Retain the intentional floor pivot instead of re-centering an asymmetric footprint.

issues.title: Shortest tent approaches crossed steep shoulders and guyline clearance
issues.affected: Hollow Creek west/east campsite placement iteration
issues.symptom: Full-width native probes found 15 approach grade samples above 0.20 (maximum 0.31169); a later contour draft exposed five lateral body/guyline contacts.
issues.cause: Centre-line access and proximity to an existing path were insufficient on the actual terrain and anchored model footprints.
issues.action: Author a western contour approach around the pitched tent, shift the eastern approach beyond the steep edge, clear only the affected decorative ferns, and test 3912 standing body samples plus 510 tread samples. Final maximum approach grade is 0.1843600; no terrain source or grade threshold was changed.
issues.evidence: development/quality/evidence/DEV-040-approach-grades-before.json; DEV-040-corridor-guylines-before.json; hollow-creek/tents.json approaches and verification/hollow-creek-tents.json.
issues.older_maps: Check full tread width and body envelope around guy ropes, pegs, terrain transitions and entries. Actual runtime movement, AI fairness and wear/approach artwork remain separate gates.

issues.title: Gallery readback aborted on a transient Pages 503
issues.symptom: The first 602-image live readback failed with HTTP 503 during an image request even though Pages was built and all seven published model/native source hashes matched.
issues.cause: The verifier had no per-URL transient retry and the legacy failure did not identify the affected image URL.
issues.action: Retry transient 429/5xx/network failures at most four times per URL, respect short Retry-After headers, defer long server backoff, log successful-run retry events and include the path on fatal failures. Keep all actual PNG/hash assertions. Final rerun verified 602 images and 156 full hashes.
issues.evidence: tools/verify_development_gallery.py; development/verification/live-development-gallery.json; initial recorded failure excerpt in development/quality/evidence/DEV-041-gallery-503-before.txt
issues.older_maps: A transient service error does not invalidate local implementation or prove remote publication failed. Preserve checkpoints and separately verify source bytes and final public image delivery.

issues.title: Shore crop and scenery returns left a jagged lake-facing seam
issues.affected: Hollow Creek coast and forest apron
issues.symptom: User-caught jagged shoreline; an intermediate linear shore return created a triangular projecting ledge.
issues.cause: Terrain cell culling and scenery-apron termination were authored independently.
issues.action: Restore 1594 missing coast triangles, match the retained apron edge, clip the west return at the terrain grid and fit its inner edge to actual terrain. Preserve old terrain checkpoints.
issues.evidence: development/levels/previews/defects/DEV-042-before-incomplete-shore-return.png; verification/hollow-creek-dock.json
issues.older_maps: Audit each older location individually for this category; scoped native fixes or shared-policy tests do not establish full other-map gameplay/art acceptance.

issues.title: Boat ends were open and corner posts pierced shed roof
issues.affected: Original dock shed and rowboat first draft
